string.name: title_open_wlan_and_bluetooth
string.value: To use ScreenCast, first enable WLAN and Bluetooth

string.name: text_open_wlan_and_bluetooth
string.value: These are required to discover devices and stream audio and video.

string.name: privacy_hint
string.value: Cast your screen to a bigger display.

string.name: projection_privacy_statement
string.value: This service requires the Device connection permission to turn on Bluetooth and use Bluetooth and WLAN. It will also record device audio and onscreen content. By tapping Agree, you agree to these terms.

string.name: error_text_code_2
string.value: Restart WLAN and Bluetooth on both devices and try again.
